title: refactor(Formalism/LocalToGlobal/TorsionIntegrality/TorsionTranslationPowers): deduplicate AnaSys via AnaSysW
body:
`AnaSys.lean` proved the analytic translation system and Weierstrass bridge for the short Weierstrass curve `curveL l L ι` by duplicating the general-model proofs in `AnaSysW.lean`, while `AnaSysW.lean` imported `AnaSys.lean` only for a few small helpers. This PR reverses that dependency: `AnaSysW.lean` drops its import of `AnaSys.lean` (proving `AnaSysW.nonsing` directly from `L.derivWeierstrassP_sq`, using `F.taylorSgStar` and `B.ParO.fExp_mul_neg`, and keeping a small private `ev_notMem` helper), and `AnaSys.lean` delegates its used declarations to `AnaSysW.lean` at `W := curveL l L ι`.

- Added in `Formalism.L2.Th1.E.AnaSys`: `unif_curveL`, `ptOf_eq_ptW` (and private `ev_notMem` in `Formalism.L2.Th1.E.AnaSysW`).
- Removed unused duplicated declarations from `Formalism.L2.Th1.E.AnaSys`: `lg0`, `lg1`, `lg_ne`, `lgS`, `inU_mul`, `inU_add`, `inU_const`, `inU_id`, `inU_congr`, `cc_inU`, `Rd`, `Rd.mul`, `Rd.add`, `Rd.const`, `Rd.id`, `analytic_opU`, `Rd.opU`, `taylorSgStar`, `inU_sgStar`, `fExp_cancel`, `cc_gT`, `opU_zero_ne`, `opU_zero_eq`, `disc_ne`, `ptOf_mem`, `ptOf_zero_iff`, `scaled_x_analytic_point`, `scaled_x_analytic_point_lattice`, `curveL_eq`, `wpInU`, `ev_notMem`, `T_wp`, `T_dwp`, `flowC`, `transC`, `prod_notMem`, `prod_mem`.
- Dropped the now-unused `TransWpBridge` argument of `Formalism.L2.Th1.E.AnalyticSys_of` and updated its sole caller in `AnalyticTransOfAdd.lean`.
